deviations: Sample restriction implemented as out-party (to-party) prior lower-house seats >= 4 (to_prior_seats), which yields exactly the paper's 1,842 dyads; applying the >=4 filter to both parties gives 1,535. US rows coded 999 seats are kept (major parties).
Coalition/opposition-partner dummies use prior_coalition / prior_opposition (codebook lists these as used in the analysis), not govern_together / opposition_together.
Left-right distance (CMP rile_distance) standardized over the estimation sample (mean 22.5, SD 17.5 vs paper's 22.4 / 17.6).
Gender-specific DV computed as 10 - dislike from gender_disagregated_8-8-21.rds (gender 2 = women, 1 = men).
notes: Three exploratory runs (no RESULT lines) inspected variables and sample filters. Final: fixest OLS with country-year (cntryyr) fixed effects, SEs clustered by cntryyr. All coefficients and Ns match Table 1 at reported precision (1.89, 1.73, 2.10, 1.13, -0.59, 0.94, 0.37; N 1842/1836/1833; 81 elections). Clustered SEs are somewhat smaller than published (e.g. 0.36 vs 0.43 on the bivariate coefficient); SEs are not among the claims. Codebook .docx files and readme.rtf in the mount were read as data documentation; no script files were opened.
